tool_input.description: Create feature group with online store enabled
Insert CSV data into feature group
Create feature view over the feature group
Test online feature lookup for one key

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p submission && python3 -c "
import json, subprocess, sys

keys = open('data/lookup_keys.txt').read().strip().split()
vectors = {}

for key in keys:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ['hops', 'fv', 'get', 'profiles501d2f_view', '--version', '1', '--entry', f'account_id={key}', '--json'],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    # parse the JSON from stdout - find the last JSON object
    stdout = result.stdout.strip()
    # find the JSON block
    start = stdout.rfind('{')
    end = stdout.rfind('}') + 1
    data = json.loads(stdout[start:end])
    vec = data['vector']
    # vec[0] is account_id, vec[1:] are f1,f2,f3,f4
    vectors[key] = [float(v) for v in vec[1:]]
    print(f'{key}: {vectors[key]}', file=sys.stderr)

with open('submission/answers.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump({'vectors': vectors}, f)
print('Done')
" 2>&1
tool_input.description: Loop through all lookup keys via online store and build answers.json

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p submission

# Start the JSON
printf '{"vectors": {' > submission/answers.json
first=1

while IFS= read -r key; do
    # Fetch from online store
    raw=$(hops fv get profiles501d2f_view --version 1 --entry "account_id=$key" --json 2>/dev/null)
    
    # Extract the 4 float values (skip the account_id string, take only numeric lines)
    # numeric lines look like: "    -7.8895," or "    5.8709"
    nums=$(printf '%s\n' "$raw" | grep -oE '\-?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -4)
    
    # Read into array
    mapfile -t vals <<< "$nums"
    
    [ $first -eq 0 ] && printf ',' >> submission/answers.json
    printf '"'"$key"'":[%s,%s,%s,%s]' "${vals[0]}" "${vals[1]}" "${vals[2]}" "${vals[3]}" >> submission/answers.json
    first=0
    printf 'Processed %s: [%s,%s,%s,%s]\n' "$key" "${vals[0]}" "${vals[1]}" "${vals[2]}" "${vals[3]}"
done < data/lookup_keys.txt

printf '}}' >> submission/answers.json
echo "Done - submission/answers.json written"

tool_input.command:

while IFS= read -r key; do
    raw=$(hops fv get profiles501d2f_view --version 1 --entry "account_id=$key" --json 2>/dev/null)
    nums=$(printf '%s\n' "$raw" | grep -oE '\-?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -4)
    f1="${nums%%$'\n'*}"
    rest="${nums#*$'\n'}"
    f2="${rest%%$'\n'*}"
    rest2="${rest#*$'\n'}"
    f3="${rest2%%$'\n'*}"
    f4="${rest2#*$'\n'}"
    [ $first -eq 0 ] && printf ',' >> submission/answers.json
    printf '"'"$key"'":[%s,%s,%s,%s]' "$f1" "$f2" "$f3" "$f4" >> submission/answers.json
    first=0
    printf '%s done\n' "$key"
done < data/lookup_keys.txt

printf '}}' >> submission/answers.json
echo "Complete"
